summary: At a return visit, an organizer recognizes a change in the audience because parents have started coming along.
realLife: Peters remembered mainly teenagers at Kennedy’s first appearance and adults joining them later.
gates: The candidate has appeared in the same area before.
inGame: needs: attendance observations from two public appearances at the same place.

turns.what: The organizer recognizes the same young faces at the second meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The return appearance falls during their parents' workday.
turns.writesBack: The organizer records no visible change in who came.

turns.what: A few parents wait by the exit and join in only after the talk.
turns.pulledBy: They came to collect their children as the meeting ended.
turns.writesBack: The organizer records conversations after the event separately from attendance during it.
